assessments.reasoning: The Using Lexical Binding section names the file-loading and buffer-evaluation cases and connects their binding mode to the buffer-local lexical-binding value. It explicitly leaves special variables dynamic.

challenge.method: Read both values of lexical-binding and check the first-line file-local setting, named direct-eval lexical argument, Lisp Interaction, IELM and interactive and command-line cases.
challenge.results: The documented file and buffer mechanism applies to the eligible local variables in the claim. Direct evaluation and special-variable declarations have their own controls.

limitations: Scope is file loading and Lisp buffer evaluation in the dated GNU manual. Interactive evaluation, direct eval and other editions have separate evidence.
